reviews.text: I’ve really been enjoying these Galactomyces Toner Pads! They’re super convenient and easy to use, especially when I’m in a hurry or don’t want to do too many steps in my skincare routine. The pads feel gentle on my skin and leave it feeling fresh, hydrated, and smooth afterward. I also like that they don’t leave a sticky or heavy feeling. My skin looks more refreshed after using them, and they’ve become a nice little addition to my routine. Definitely worth trying if you like simple and easy skincare products!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意用呢款 Galactomyces Toner Pads！佢哋好方便、易用，特別係我趕時間或者唔想做太多護膚步驟嗰陣。片子用起嚟對皮膚好温和，用完令皮膚感覺清新、水潤、順滑。我都鍾意佢哋唔會令皮膚黏或者厚重。用完皮膚睇落更清新，而家成為我護膚步驟嘅一個好小補充。如果你鍾意簡單易用嘅護膚產品，絕對值得試！

reviews.text: These toner pads are really nice and very easy to use. They gently exfoliate and help smooth the skin while adding moisture at the same time. The galactomyces essence makes my skin look brighter and more even after use. They feel gentle, not irritating, and leave the skin fresh and clean. Great for quick skincare days or for prepping the skin before makeup.
reviews.zh: 呢款爽膚棉片好好用，非常易用。佢哋可以温和去角質，令皮膚更順滑，同時補充水分。Galactomyces 精華令我皮膚用完之後更亮、更均勻。佢哋用起嚟温和，唔刺激，令皮膚清新、乾淨。好啱趕時間嘅護膚日，或者上妝前準備皮膚。

reviews.text: These toner pads are very gentle and refreshing on the skin. They feel soothing and help hydrate without causing irritation. I like using them as a first step after cleansing to prep my skin. The pads are well soaked and easy to use, and my skin feels smoother and more balanced after using them. Great for sensitive skin and daily use.
reviews.zh: 呢款爽膚棉片好温和、清爽。用起嚟感覺舒緩，有補水效果，唔會令人不適。我鍾意用佢做潔面後嘅第一步，為皮膚做準備。棉片吸收咗足夠精華，又好易用，用完我嘅皮膚感覺更加平衡、順滑。好啱敏感皮膚同日常使用。

reviews.text:
I was pleasantly surprised by these mixsoon Galactomyces Toner Pads. The pads are super gentle, non-irritating, and have a light, refreshing texture. After using them, my skin feels hydrated and looks fresh and smooth.
The Galactomyces really help to improve the skin tone — it becomes soft, even, and naturally glowing.
They work great even on sensitive skin and leave no sticky feeling.
Perfect to use in the morning or before applying cream.
I’ll definitely repurchase! 💖
reviews.zh:
我對 mixsoon Galactomyces 爽膚棉片感到驚喜。棉片非常温和，唔刺激，質地輕盈清新。用完之後，我嘅皮膚感覺水潤，睇落清新、順滑。
Galactomyces 真係幫助改善膚色——皮膚變得軟滑、均勻，而且自然有光澤。
即使係敏感皮膚都好用，亦冇黏膩感。
早上用或者喺擦面霜前用都好好。
我一定會再買！💖

reviews.text:
These toner pads have become a quick favorite in my routine! They’re soaked in Galactomyces ferment filtrate, which helps brighten, smooth, and balance the skin.
✨ Texture: Thin and soft pads with plenty of essence — feel refreshing and gentle on the skin.
✨ Performance: Leave my skin hydrated, smooth, and glowy without any stickiness. They also help refine texture and prep the skin perfectly for the next steps.
✨ Feels: Cooling and soothing, great for a morning refresh or a quick skincare boost anytime.
✔️ Perfect for dull, uneven, or tired skin.
❌ If you prefer exfoliating pads, these are more hydrating than exfoliating.
Overall: A gentle, brightening toner pad that gives my skin a healthy glow and silky smooth feel 🌿
reviews.zh:
呢款爽膚棉片快速成為我護膚程序入面嘅最愛！佢哋浸滿 Galactomyces 發酵濾液，有助提亮、順滑同平衡皮膚。
✨ 質地：薄而軟嘅棉片，精華充足——感覺清新、温和。
✨ 效果：令我皮膚水潤、順滑、有光澤，冇黏膩感。佢哋仲有助細化紋理，為之後嘅護膚步驟做好準備。
✨ 感受：有清涼舒緩感，早上提神或者任何時候快速補充護膚都好啱。
✔️ 適合暗啞、不均勻或者疲倦嘅皮膚。
❌ 如果你想要去角質棉片，呢款更偏向補水多於去角質。
總括：一款温和、提亮嘅爽膚棉片，令我皮膚有健康光澤，同埋絲滑嘅感覺 🌿

reviews.text: These toner pads are soaked with just the right amount of product, making them easy to use and very refreshing. They gently exfoliate and hydrate at the same time, leaving my skin smoother, brighter, and ready to absorb the rest of my skincare. I love how convenient they are for both morning and evening routines.
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝棉嘅精華液份量啱啱好，用起嚟好方便，而且好清爽。佢可以溫和去角質，同時保濕，令皮膚更加順滑、更加亮，準備好吸收之後嘅護膚產品。我好鍾意佢朝早同晚上嘅護膚程序都咁方便。

reviews.text: These toner pads are so easy to use and super gentle! They give a light exfoliation with glycolic acid but don’t dry out the skin at all. My face feels smoother and looks more even after just a few uses. Plus, they’re soaked in hydrating ingredients, so you get glow and moisture in one step. Great for a quick skin refresh.
reviews.zh: 呢款爽膚棉片好容易用，又非常温和！用含甘醇酸嘅輕微去角質效果，但係唔會令皮膚乾燥。用咗幾次之後，我嘅面睇起嚟更加順滑、更均勻。仲有，佢哋浸滿咗補水成分，一步就可以同時獲得光澤同水分。快速護膚嘅好選擇。

reviews.text: It gave me glass skin. The smell was not the best but I prefer that over added fragrances so please never add them to a formula. I loved these and the fact that they could be split into smaller pieces. I tried other toner pads after these but they werent as good. I really noticed these gave me a lot of plump and gloss
reviews.zh: 呢款令我有咗玻璃肌。味道唔係最好，但係我寧願佢咁，都唔想加入人工香料，所以請永遠唔好喺配方入面加香料。我好鍾意呢啲，仲鍾意佢哋可以撕成細件嘅設計。我用過其他爽膚棉片之後，覺得佢哋唔夠好。我真係覺得呢啲令我皮膚飽滿咗好多，又有好多光澤。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
